items.text: Check-every-field rules: ID, name, birth date and gender must all agree.
items.detail: Finds the card's ID, then insists that name, birth date and gender all agree, even when the ID already picked one person.

items.label: ✓ Found the right person
items.value: One member was the person in the request, and the matcher returned that member.

items.label: ✓ Rightly refused: not this person
items.value: The card and the person don't agree, so nobody should be returned. The matcher refused (HRex 422).

items.label: ✓ Rightly refused: can't tell apart
items.value: More than one member fits the request equally. HRex says refuse (422), and the matcher did.

items.label: ✓ Rightly refused: consent
items.value: The consent sent with the request can't be honoured, so HRex says refuse (422). The matcher did.

items.label: ✗ Wrong person
items.value: The matcher returned a member who is not the person asking, or returned someone when it should have refused. This is how one person's records reach another.

items.label: ✗ Ignored consent
items.value: The matcher returned the right person despite a consent the plan can't honour.

items.label: ✗ Missed the right person
items.value: One member was the right answer, but the matcher refused. Safe, but the member's records don't move.

items.label: ✗ No usable answer
items.value: The matcher crashed or answered in a form that isn't a valid $member-match response.

footnote: Checked against the locked answer key afd4a0787ca3. Any HRex 422 refusal where one is due counts as right.
